The undergraduate tuition fees for the School of Information Technology and Computer Science for the 2026/2027 academic year are 193,680 EGP for the first year (Freshman) only [1].

Official pages for details and updates: [Fees and Financials — 2026/2027](https://nu.edu.eg/fees-and-financials).
